caption: The drawing depicts a padlock-shaped object composed primarily of wood. The shackle at the top is a smoothly curved, looped structure with visible wood grain, colored in light and medium brown tones. The body of the lock is angular, having a broad and irregular polygonal shape with beveled edges and an integrated wood grain pattern throughout, marked by distinct striations and subtle knotholes characteristic of natural wood. In the center-bottom portion of the lock body, there is a circular indented area resembling a keyhole or wood plug. The overall color palette is comprised mainly of various shades of beige and light brown, with the background being a plain, slightly yellowed off-white paper. The drawing style is photorealistic, capturing texture and form with meticulous shading.
title: Single Ox Yoke
